title: HtmlHead
responsibility: Renders the native head element without extra wrapper DOM or feature behavior.

inputs.name: HtmlHead.attributes
inputs.description: Native head attributes and event handlers. The native atom call preserves Svelte bindings, actions and scoped styles.

inputs.name: HtmlHead.children
inputs.description: Optional content within the native head element; native HTML content rules still apply.

outputs.name: HtmlHead
outputs.description: The actual native head element, with forwarded attributes and content and no additional wrapper.
